purpose: Compare full output consumption with length-only on the same integrated Go and frozen JS formatter; compiler source unchanged.

environment.hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 14 cores, macOS arm64

protocol.fixture: bench/fixture.purs (514 lines, ASCII); formatted output 14624 bytes
protocol.order: six balanced positions, repeated three times; every sample retained
protocol.timing: wall-clock process duration including startup; no GC instrumentation or concurrent task builds
protocol.drivers: same direct formatOnce driver per backend for all three modes; input loaded before allocation counters

modes.utf16: FNV-1a-style 32-bit accumulation of every UTF-16 code unit, including reconstructed surrogate pairs in Go
modes.utf8: UTF-8 Buffer.from and FNV-1a32 in JS; FNV-1a32 over native UTF-8 string bytes in Go; sum of all ten hashes is printed

protocol.allocations: 3 separate runs per backend/mode; Go TotalAlloc/Mallocs deltas; JS estimated heap growth summed from allocated= GC traces between forced GCs, external buffers separately accounted
protocol.JS_allocations_crosscheck: 3 separate Inspector sampling runs (32768-byte interval, objects collected by minor/major GC included); estimates, not exact equivalence with Go counters
protocol.JS_empty_control_limit: One empty control showed unsigned underflow (2^64-136), reflecting negative heap-size growth; no affected workload traces; no empty control subtracted
protocol.unicode_scope: Verification requires well-formed Unicode; isolated surrogate output rejected rather than compared with different encoders

empty_JS_controls.interpretation: size_t subtraction wrapped on a small negative heap-size change; not an allocation count; control not subtracted from workload

JS_sampling_crosscheck.method: HeapProfiler.startSampling interval32768, includeObjectsCollectedByMinorGC=true and includeObjectsCollectedByMajorGC=true, GC before start and before stop. Sum all node selfSize. No trace-gc simultaneously. External Buffer backing stores excluded.
notes: Sampling estimates cumulative allocated V8 heap objects including objects collected during workload, not retained heap.
Individual profile.samples size sums differ slightly due per-sample versus aggregated statistical rounding; node selfSize sum is used consistently.

Trace-gc empty control produced size_t wraparound 2^64-136. This confirms trace allocated is not a strict monotone total-allocation counter. No absurd entries observed in the 9 non-empty workload traces per root audit.

First sampled run completed with expected observed checksum32412660080; an incorrectly typed harness assertion then failed before report write. Its full profile and result are retained as run1, not discarded.

historical_context.note: New driver and current measurement campaign; compare modes within this campaign, not small changes across campaigns.
historical_context.altbak_scope: Different workload, not a formatter parity result; its tables were not modified.

conclusions.runtime: Full consumption does not remove the measured runtime gap. Do not interpret the small change of ratio as a demonstrated ropes effect: paired intervals overlap zero and JS process durations are dispersed.
conclusions.allocations: About 0.93 GB estimated V8 heap allocation versus 0.94 GB Go TotalAlloc per ten iterations; comparable order of magnitude, not a precise cross-runtime ranking.
conclusions.correctness: Go matches prior outputs on 9 source files; Go/JS bytes, UTF16 hashes and UTF8 hashes match on the main fixture plus 16 extra cases. Six malformed cases compare empty formatter results, not diagnostics.

JS_frontend_provenance: Typed PureScript fork 0.15.16, identified from generated module headers. This historical reference is not the official PureScript 0.15.15 used by the current application table.
